description: This file defines the ClaimPluginConfiguration class which implements plugin configuration for the claim feature in the OrangeHRM system. It registers the ClaimService in the application's service container during initialization.

classes.name: ClaimPluginConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for the claim plugin that initializes required services during plugin setup.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Registers the ClaimService to the container when called with an HTTP request.
